sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
PR Newswire is the industry's leading press release distribution partner with an unparalleled global reach of more than 440,000 newsrooms, websites, direct feeds, journalists and influencers available in more than 170 countries and 40 languages.

Industry: Media and Communications · Size: $1B+ · Products: PR Newswire Amplify platform, Create+, Plan module, Press Release Score, PR Newswire for Journalists

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: PR Newswire scores 26 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by company size (15/15) and event engagement (11/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (13% similar on media, commercial, release, resources); Mactac (8% similar on media, chemical, resources, commercial). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
